entities.summary: Igor Alexandrovich Putin is a Russian businessman and politician, former vice president of Master Bank. He is a first cousin of the Russian president, Vladimir Putin. He is the chairman of Igor Putin Fund, an investment company supporting and developing the industry in outlying regions of Russia.
